reason: A DeepSeek Harness web GUI plugin that visualizes estimated remaining task time, token usage, and model-based costs in the session header, with optional LLM-powered estimates and configurable local settings.

summaries.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 会话标题栏中展示任务剩余时间、Token 用量和按模型花费估算，并支持可选的 LLM 智能估算。
summaries.en: Displays estimated remaining task time, token usage, and per-model costs in the DeepSeek Harness session header, with optional LLM-powered estimates.

capabilities: Reads session statistics, token usage, goals, and session logs
Computes heuristic, per-round, PERT, and cost estimates
Displays estimates and details in the session header UI
Optionally invokes the configured model for an LLM-powered estimate
Allows local editing and persistence of pricing and refresh settings
